highlights: Accurate product grid and navigation mirroring Amazon’s UI
Custom hover and transition effects for product cards
Fully responsive design that adapts to desktop, tablet, and mobile screens
Semantic markup and clean CSS architecture for easy maintenance

name: FECProject_Avinash
summary: FECProject_Avinash is a responsive web portal that presents the outcomes and resources of the FEC initiative, delivering clear navigation and interactive content for users. It stands out with its custom data visualizations, seamless third‑party API integration, and rigorous accessibility compliance, ensuring an engaging experience across devices.
highlights: Dynamic charts visualizing project metrics
Live integration with external data API
Form handling with client‑side validation
WCAG‑AA accessibility features
